summary: New decisions carry the exact outline Context, Decision, Alternatives considered, Consequences, and Verification on the current profile authored in each record shard; decisions accepted earlier stay on a legacy profile bounded by the closed historical set frozen in the index schema, the Domain stays in the record shard field, and an optional decision acceptance-criteria section parses under either heading spelling, with fenced criteria included and every matching section read, while a legacy criteria section stays recorded unparsed and the spec rule stays unchanged.
title: The decision record outline is versioned
